Name: Search Mails
Author: admin
Description: Search for specific emails in configured mailbox using multiple provided search criteria. Action return information on found in mailbox emails in JSON format. NOTICE - to search for an email in all mailboxes, please configure impersonation permissions. https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/exchange/client-developer/exchange-web-services/impersonation-and-ews-in-exchange. Note: Action is running as async, please adjust script timeout value in Siemplify IDE for action as needed.

Parameters.Description: Parameter can be used to specify email folder on the mailbox to search for the emails. Parameter should also accept comma separated list of folders to check the user response in multiple folders. Parameter is case sensitive. '/' separator can be used to specify a subfolder to search in, example: Inbox/Subfolder
Specify a comma-separated list of message ids that need to be searched. Note: this filter has priority over the other ones.
Filter condition, specify what subject to search for emails
Filter condition, specify who should be the sender of needed emails
Filter condition, specify who should be the recipient of needed emails
Filter condition, specify in what time frame in minutes should action look for emails
Filter condition, specify if search should look only for unread emails
Return max X emails as an action result
If checked, search in all mailboxes accessible with current impersonalization settings. If delegated access is used, implicitly specify the mailboxes to search in the "Mailboxes" parameter.

Parameters.Description: In case "Search in all mailboxes" is checked, action works in batches, this parameter controls how many mailboxes action should process in single batch (single connection to mail server).
Specify a comma-separated list of mailboxes that need to be searched. This parameter has priority over "Search in all mailboxes".
Specify the start time for the email search. Format: ISO 8601. This parameter has a priority over "Time Frame (minutes)".
Specify the end time for the email search. Format: ISO 8601. If nothing is provided and "Start Time" is valid then this parameter will use current time.
Specify a regex pattern that needs to be searched in body part of the email.

AIDescription:
Searches for specific emails within Microsoft Exchange mailboxes based on a variety of configurable criteria. This action is designed to perform broad or targeted searches across one or many mailboxes, retrieving email metadata and body content. It operates asynchronously to handle large-scale searches across multiple mailboxes without exceeding script timeouts.

### Parameters Description

| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Folder Name | String | No | Specifies the email folder(s) to search (e.g., 'Inbox'). Supports comma-separated lists and subfolders using the '/' separator (e.g., 'Inbox/Subfolder'). Default is 'Inbox'. |
| Message IDs | String | No | A comma-separated list of specific Message IDs to search for. This filter has priority over other criteria. |
| Subject Filter | String | No | Filters emails by a specific subject string. |
| Sender Filter | String | No | Filters emails by the sender's email address. |
| Recipient Filter | String | No | Filters emails by the recipient's email address. |
| Time Frame (minutes) | String | No | The lookback window in minutes for the search. |
| Only Unread | Boolean | No | If set to true, the search will only return unread emails. |
| Max Emails To Return | String | No | Limits the total number of emails returned by the action. Default is 100. |
| Search in all mailboxes | Boolean | No | If enabled, the action searches all mailboxes accessible via the configured impersonation settings. |
| How many mailboxes to process in a single batch | String | No | Controls the number of mailboxes processed in a single asynchronous execution cycle. Default is 25. |
| Mailboxes | String | No | A comma-separated list of specific mailbox addresses to search. This parameter takes priority over 'Search in all mailboxes'. |
| Start Time | String | No | The start time for the search range in ISO 8601 format. Takes priority over 'Time Frame (minutes)'. |
| End Time | String | No | The end time for the search range in ISO 8601 format. Defaults to the current time if 'Start Time' is provided. |
| Body Regex Filter | String | No | A regular expression pattern to search for within the body of the emails. |

### Additional Notes
- **Permissions:** To search across all mailboxes, the integration must be configured with appropriate impersonation or delegated access permissions in Exchange.
- **Async Execution:** The action runs asynchronously. If searching many mailboxes, it will process them in batches and resume until completion.
- **Priority:** 'Message IDs' and 'Mailboxes' parameters override broader search settings.

### Flow Description
1. **Initialization:** The action initializes the Exchange manager using the integration's configuration (Server Address, Credentials, etc.).
2. **Target Identification:** It identifies which mailboxes to search based on the 'Mailboxes' list or by fetching all searchable mailboxes if 'Search in all mailboxes' is selected.
3. **Time Filtering:** It establishes the search time window using 'Start Time'/'End Time' or the 'Time Frame' lookback.
4. **Batch Processing:** The action processes mailboxes in batches. For each mailbox in the current batch, it searches the specified folders.
5. **Criteria Application:** It applies filters for Message IDs, Subject, Sender, Recipient, and Body Regex. It also respects the 'Only Unread' and 'Max Emails' constraints.
6. **Data Collection:** Matching emails are retrieved, and their details (Subject, Author, Body, etc.) are collected.
7. **State Management:** If more mailboxes remain after a batch, the action saves its progress and enters an 'In Progress' state for the next async cycle.
8. **Completion:** Once all mailboxes are processed, it generates a data table of matching emails and returns the full results in JSON format.
